column1: # Brighter-pixel census, ROUND 2. Registered and committed BEFORE running (2026-10-14). Round 1 (plan e915ab5, run 02103bf)
# skipped all 27 items: its flatness rule measured text density. Same items, same windows; three changes, marked [R2].
#   [R2] fill = mode of L over the window pixels ABOVE the window's median (if none is above it, i.e. the median equals the
#              window maximum, the pixels at or above it). Lowest value on ties. Dark text on a light fill -> the background.
#   mask     = window pixels with L <= fill - 4. Empty -> NO-MARKS, ineligible.
#   far      = window pixels more than 2 px from any mask pixel (outside the 8-connected dilation x2 of the mask).
#   [R2] eligible = the fill value covers >= 50% of `far`. Empty far or < 50% -> SKIPPED.
#            Eligibility (EXCLUDED / NO-MARKS / SKIPPED) is decided from flatness alone, before and independently of the
#   nbrs     = pixels within 2 px of the mask, not in the mask, inside the window.
#   bright   = nbrs with L >= fill + 1 (count, max).   FAR = far pixels with L >= fill + 1.
#   status   = SHOWS if bright > 0 and FAR == 0;  INDETERMINATE if bright > 0 and FAR > 0;  NONE if bright == 0.
#   Decision set = the ELIGIBLE items with role overlay-s9 or overlay-numeral. Ineligible items are listed by name and count
#   Write "the tablet marks share the rendering signature of the faint overlay texts" only if: the subject is eligible and
#   SHOWS; at least 3 decision-set items are eligible and every one of them SHOWS (INDETERMINATE or NONE does not count as
#   showing); and no eligible control SHOWS or is INDETERMINATE.
#   Fewer than 3 eligible overlay items -> record "cannot be decided at this resolution" with the eligibility table, and close
#   the thread: no round 3. Otherwise, if the conditions are not all met -> record as mixed, with the table.
#   Role additional: measured and reported, outside the rule. No reading of what any item says.
